dct_description_sm: Abstract: World Named Latitudes and Longitudes contains geographically significant lines of reference such as the equator, tropics, Arctic and Antarctic circles, prime meridian, and international date line. It also contains their names and values as attributes.
Purpose: Dataset was developed for use by GIS software in global or continental scale applications.
